item.title: Man sentenced after being convicted of sex trafficking 5 young people in Chicago, Lansing
item.description: Here's how local and federal authorities cracked a Chicago sex trafficking case.

item.title: Elgin woman frustrated by Amazon deliveries, packages she didn't order
item.description: Imagine receiving dozens of mysterious Amazon packages at your doorstep. A woman in the Chicago area says she didn't order anything, yet more than 100 packages have shown up at her home, and she wants it to stop.

item.title: Man accused of poisoning Southern California couple by spraying bug spray on food
item.description: A couple is speaking out after their roommate allegedly poisoned them, leading to a standoff with deputies. Video shows the man spraying bug spray on their groceries.

item.title: Power outage, wire issues impact Metra train service at Millennium Station in the Loop
item.description: A power outage and wire issues at Metra's Millennium Station in the Loop impacted service on train lines Friday night, officials said. The issues were later resolved.

item.title: 'Gabe The Travel Guy' in Brisbane, Australia
item.description: Gabe Saglie, "Gabe The Travel Guy," joined ABC7 on Friday to share some travel tips... from Brisbane, Australia!

item.title: FAA to ask airlines to reduce flights at Chicago's O'Hare airport this summer
item.description: The Federal Aviation Administration will be asking airlines to reduces flights at Chicago's O'Hare airport this summer.

item.title: Pedestrian killed in Winthrop Harbor hit-and-run, police say; daughter offers reward in case
item.description: The daughter of a 50-year-old woman killed in a suburban hit-and-run crash said she was the type of woman to give the shirt off of her back. They can't comprehend how someone would simply leave her on the side of the road.

item.title: Thousands continue to pay respects to Rev. Jesse Jackson on 2nd day of visitation at Rainbow PUSH
item.description: Memorial services for the Rev. Jesse Jackson Sr. continued Friday in Chicago, before events in Washington, D.C., and South Carolina, where he was born, to honor his long civil rights legacy.

item.title: Disaster as fencing wire gets tangled in spinning car wash in North Carolina
item.description: The first rule of going to the car wash with your truck is make sure there's nothing in the bed. A North Carolina man found that out the hard way.

item.title: Israel's defense minister says his country has attacked Iran and declares a state of emergency
item.description: Israel launched a daylight attack Saturday on Iran's capital, with a cloud of smoke rising from the city's downtown.
